exact_response:
Historical injustices deserve acknowledgment, but being white does not make someone personally responsible for what other white people did.

An apology is appropriate for someone’s own actions, or from an institution taking responsibility for its history. People can also recognize continuing harms and help address them without accepting guilt solely because of their race.
